notes.title: Patch Demo V0.1.8-4
notes.content:
Dear Dungeoncrawlers!

Version 0.1.8-4 brings some balancing, improvements, and bug fixes. The balance of the game continuously revised.

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Balanced slot machines
[*] Reduced speed of the large fire slime
[*] Reduced missile speed
[*] Reduced additional speed for rage
[*] Added Etherium crates so you can find more Etherium in the depths
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Reduced several slomo durations
[*] Reduced slippery of the sprint
[*] Added target FPS option
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed screenshake settings
[/list]

Known bugs:
[list]
[*] Key binding resets sometimes.

[*] More Start HP
[*] Higher meat(heals) drop chance
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Added DPad UI navigation
[*] Added toggle for PixelPerfect. Default: disabled (disabled - no jitter, less beautiful, enabled - a bit jitter, very beautiful)
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] The screenshake settings now work for all types of screenshake
